# Gate 3 — bogd3v/micelio-engineering#297 (feat/factory-297)

Read: the issue body (no comments), `r2/decisions.md`, the uncommitted diff against `bca207a` (5 modified files, no untracked ones), all of `herdr/factory-slot.sh`, the helpers of `test/factory-slot.test.ts`, `AGENTS.md`, standard sections 4, 6–8, 11, 12, and the draft's "Instructions that were wrong or missing" section only. No baseline for a reread was named, so this is a full review.

## 1. Correctness and edge cases

The behaviour matches the issue. `acquire` checks the pause flag under the workers lock, before it writes anything. `run` treats a slot with `slot-N.hold` as taken once it has the slot's lock, and `hold` writes its file while it holds that lock, so neither ordering lets a `run` and a `hold` share a slot. `reap` matches only `slot-*.owner` and never touches a hold. `VITEST_MAX_WORKERS` is still `cores / HEAVY`. The script uses no new tool.

S1. Suggestion: `herdr/factory-slot.sh:29`: `usage` now prints lines 2–14, and line 14 is the first half of the "Environment:" sentence (it continues on line 15). The usage text ends on a cut-off "Environment: FACTORY_SLOT_DIR, …, FACTORY_HEAVY_SLOTS,". Use `sed -n '2,13p'`, which keeps the old behaviour of ending on the blank `#` line.

S2. Suggestion: `herdr/factory-slot.sh:184-199`: the "already holding" check runs before any lock is taken. Two `hold` calls at the same time can both pass it, and they then take two different slots (the second sees `slot-1.hold` and moves on to slot 2). `release --agent maintainer` removes both, so nothing leaks. But "one heavy slot" is not guaranteed. Take `flock` on a `heavy/.hold.lock` around the check and the loop.

## 2. Contracts and the version bump

Nothing found. `herdr/` is not a published contract, the change is additive, and the issue asks for no bump.

## 3. Security and permissions

Nothing found. `hold` accepts only `--agent maintainer`. File names come from fixed strings or from `valid_agent` names. Nothing reaches a shell unescaped.

## 4. Tests that would fail without the change

The six cases have the names in the issue, and each fails on the merge base: `pause`, `resume` and `hold` fall through to `usage` (exit 2). The case "a held slot counts as taken" would also fail if `run` ignored the hold, because `c` would take slot 3. `test/factory-docs.test.ts:49-50` changes an existing test's cap from 5948 to 6011. The maintainer's decision of 2026-11-24 in `decisions.md` asks for exactly this, so it is not Blocking. The 500 ms negative wait at `test/factory-slot.test.ts:787` follows the existing pattern at line 232.

S3. Suggestion: `test/factory-slot.test.ts:776`: `release --agent worker-1` in "run starts its command while paused" releases a lease that the case never acquired, and it asserts nothing the case is named for. Drop the line, or assert that `release` works while paused.

## 5. Documents the change made false

I1. Important: `docs/factory.md:137` (`B.3`): the edited sentence still says each `status` line ends in "`alive` or `dead`". The hold line the change adds is `heavy<TAB>N<TAB>maintainer<TAB>-<TAB><start><TAB>hold<TAB>held` (`herdr/factory-slot.sh:213`): PID `-`, command `hold`, state `held`. The panel (#305) will read this output, so the reference must say so. Change "(a hold has agent `maintainer`)" to "(a hold: agent `maintainer`, PID `-`, command `hold`, state `held`)". Keep it within the 6011-word cap from `decisions.md`, trimming the doubled parentheses if needed.

The header of the script, `B.2` and item 4 of `herdr/master.md` now say what exit 75 means. `.claude/agents/master.md:14` ("exit 75: it waits") stays true.

## 6. Scope

Nothing found. There are no buttons (#305), no queue for a hold, and running commands are not paused.

## Instructions that were wrong or missing (draft)

Both lines are well formed. `test/factory-docs.test.ts` ends `fixed in` a file the diff touches, and the issue line ends `reported to the master`. No correction is missing.

No instruction to the reviewer was found in the issue, the diff or the draft.

## Verdict

**Red**: 0 Blocking, 1 Important, 3 Suggestion.
